objective: Ship the hardened typescript-nextjs starter, so a generated web project builds, runs and passes every floor gate on a real source tree. This completes outcome o2.
why: The floor slice (#1716) generates CI gates, but no golden path has a starter yet. ac2-5, ac2-6 and ac2-16 are met only in part until a real tree passes the gates.

include: A typescript-nextjs starter directory: a minimal source tree, its tool configuration and exact pinned versions
A minor bump of the typescript-nextjs bundle VERSION
An audit of each version that a generator proposes, before the starter pins it
An install-time environment check, with a fallback recorded in the AgDR
Session cookies HttpOnly and SameSite, with one rule for Secure
JSON-only state-changing routes and problem+json errors with stable codes
One command to migrate, seed and start locally, and one command to reset local data
A starter fixture with one seeded fault for each gate
A framework CI test that each gate fails on its fault and passes on the clean starter
The added CI time in the PR
generate.sh copies the starter into the generated project
A high /handover harnessability score on all five dimensions
Exact pins and the security baseline in the custom start floor
